description_compelling: An organized armed group challenges the state for territory or control, producing sustained combat and mass displacement. Years out, you see regulatory-quality scores, ethnic-power-balance measures, and per-capita-growth metrics drift downward together. Recurrent in weak-state belts: the Sahel, the Horn, parts of South and Southeast Asia.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
